security.uw_rationale: Controlled access to all main building with good security and police at most locations, but day to day shops easy access, but as expected

risk_adjustments.uw_general_comments: Singpost (Singapore post), this includes their main sorting offices that are located outside of CBD and in areas that would be considered low risk. We also cover all of the post boxes / parcel collection lockers etc across all of Singapore. These are the "higher" side of the risk but due to the relativaley low TSI even if one was damaged during a terrorism event, our exposure is expected to be very low. Discussed with team about writing this 100% and due to the 3 large locations being in very low risk area and in essence similar to a warehouse, we agreed to write the risk 100%.
